newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ELBER THREATENS TO LEAVE GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ELBER THREATENS TO LEAVE GERMANY.

text.p: Stuttgart's Brazilian striker Giovane Elber, the Bundesliga's third-best scorer with 10 goals, said on Monday he was frustrated by a stalemate over his contract and threatened to leave Germany.
"I am fed up with the way the negotiations are going. Maybe it would be better if I leave the club and return to Brazil," Elber said in an interview with Kicker magazine.

Elber, who said other clubs were keen to sign him, has told Stuttgart he wants a big wage increase. He said Stuttgart, who have him under contract until June 1997 with an option to extend, had yet to make him a new offer.

Stuttgart were the surprise of the recently-completed first half of the season, holding on to first place until early December thanks to a high-powered attack led by Elber. But they slipped to fourth place in the final weeks of the autumn round.
